name: CrowdHuman: Benchmark for Human Detection in Crowded Scenes
description: CrowdHuman is a large-scale object detection benchmark specifically designed to address crowded pedestrian detection and occlusion challenges. It comprises 24,370 images collected from Google image search (15,000 train, 4,370 validation, and 5,000 test images) containing approximately 470,000 human instances (an average of 22.6 persons per image). Each human instance is annotated with three bounding boxes: head bounding box, visible-body bounding box, and estimated full-body bounding box, enabling fine-grained occluded pedestrian detection, instance parsing, and robust crowd density estimation.
